selection_basis: next 14 numeric subjects after the incomplete v0.1 cohort; fixed after header-only topology audit and before any v0.2 signal-derived outcome

channel_space.derivation: exact intersection of dataset-wide eyes-open header-stable labels with the pre-existing ds003775 matched reference
channel_space.semantic_rule: exact labels only; no case normalization, interpolation, renaming, or imputation

source_identity_rule: Resolve git-annex identities for VHDR, VMRK and EEG from the pinned OpenNeuro commit; download all three from the declared NEMAR mirror; require exact size/MD5 before feature extraction.
metadata_firewall: Only subject identity, session, task, acquisition/decoding metadata, exact source identity, and the prospectively frozen 57-label coordinate manifest are visible.
claim_ceiling: Untouched within-dataset independent-subject descriptive replication of the session-pair pattern only; no modal damping, natural frequency, lowercase chi, capital Chi, diagnosis, recovery, treatment, or broad population generalization.
